steps.title: Write a switch with three type-sensitive cases
steps.instructions: Create a variable called value. Write a switch on value with three cases in this order: case false, case 0, case '0' (the string). Each case should log which one matched, and end with a break. Add a default too.

steps.title: Predict three runs
steps.instructions: Before running, write three comments predicting what happens when value is the number 0, when it is the boolean false, and when it is the string '0'. Then set value to each in turn, run, and check your predictions.
